Ottoman Egypt.fact: Meanwhile, Çeşteci Ali Pasha had arrived at Alexandria and was met by a deputation from Cairo telling him that he was not wanted. The garrison of Alexandria then attacked the castle and rescued the prisoner, whereupon Çeşteci Ali Pasha was compelled to reembark on his ship and escape.

Ottoman Egypt.subject: Indian Languages
Ottoman Egypt.question: Shortly thereafter, a rescript arrived from Constantinople confirming _____ in the governorship
Ottoman Egypt.fact: Shortly thereafter, a rescript arrived from Constantinople confirming Kara Mustafa Pasha in the governorship.

Ottoman Egypt.subject: Indian Languages
Ottoman Egypt.question: Mustafa was succeeded by Bayram Pasha in _____
Ottoman Egypt.fact: Mustafa was succeeded by Bayram Pasha in 1626.

Ottoman Egypt.subject: Indian Languages
Ottoman Egypt.question: Thus Ridwan Bey, a Mamluk emir, was able to exercise de facto authority over Egypt from _____ to 1656
Ottoman Egypt.fact: Thus Ridwan Bey, a Mamluk emir, was able to exercise de facto authority over Egypt from 1631 to 1656. In 1631, a rescript came from Constantinople, approving the conduct of the army and appointing Halil Pasha as Koca Musa Pasha's successor.

Ottoman Egypt.subject: Indian Languages
Ottoman Egypt.question: In _____, a rescript came from Constantinople, approving the conduct of the army and appointing Halil Pasha as Koca Musa Pasha's successor
Ottoman Egypt.fact: Thus Ridwan Bey, a Mamluk emir, was able to exercise de facto authority over Egypt from 1631 to 1656. In 1631, a rescript came from Constantinople, approving the conduct of the army and appointing Halil Pasha as Koca Musa Pasha's successor.

Ottoman Egypt.subject: Indian Languages
Ottoman Egypt.question: In the spring of _____, pestilence is said to have killed 635,000 persons and, in 1643, completely desolated 230 villages
Ottoman Egypt.fact: In the spring of 1619, pestilence is said to have killed 635,000 persons and, in 1643, completely desolated 230 villages.

Ottoman Egypt.subject: Indian Languages
Ottoman Egypt.question: The 17th century saw the development of two distinct factions within Egypt who continually vied for power, the _____ and the Qasimi
Ottoman Egypt.fact: The 17th century saw the development of two distinct factions within Egypt who continually vied for power, the Faqari and the Qasimi. The Faqari had strong links to the Ottoman cavalry and donned white colours and used the Pomegranate as their symbol.

Ottoman Egypt.subject: Indian Languages
Ottoman Egypt.question: The Faqari had strong links to the Ottoman cavalry and donned white colours and used the _____ as their symbol
Ottoman Egypt.fact: The Faqari had strong links to the Ottoman cavalry and donned white colours and used the Pomegranate as their symbol.

Ottoman Egypt.subject: Indian Languages
Ottoman Egypt.question: Conversely, the _____ were aligned with native Egyptian troops and donned red as their colour and adopted a disc shaped symbol as their banner
Ottoman Egypt.fact: The 17th century saw the development of two distinct factions within Egypt who continually vied for power, the Faqari and the Qasimi. Conversely, the Qasimi were aligned with native Egyptian troops and donned red as their colour and adopted a disc shaped symbol as their banner.

Ottoman Egypt.subject: Indian Languages
Ottoman Egypt.question: By the end of the _____ these factions were well established and wielded a significant amount of influence over Ottoman governors
Ottoman Egypt.fact: The 17th century saw the development of two distinct factions within Egypt who continually vied for power, the Faqari and the Qasimi. By the end of the Century these factions were well set up and wielded a significant amount of influence over Ottoman governors.

Ottoman Egypt.subject: Indian Languages
Ottoman Egypt.question: Between 1688 and 1755, _____ beys, allied with Bedouin and factions within the Ottoman garrison, deposed at least thirty-four governors
Ottoman Egypt.fact: Between 1688 and 1755, Mamluk beys, allied with Bedouin and factions within the Ottoman garrison, deposed at least thirty-four governors.

Ottoman Egypt.subject: Indian Languages
Ottoman Egypt.question: The process by which this came about is obscure, owing to the want of good chronicles for the _____ period of Egyptian history
Ottoman Egypt.fact: The process by which this came about is obscure, owing to the want of good chronicles for the Turkish period of Egyptian history.

Ottoman Egypt.subject: Indian Languages
Ottoman Egypt.question: At the end of that time, _____ was killed and the office which he had held was given to his son Ismail
Ottoman Egypt.fact: In 1707, the shaykh al-balad, Qasim Iywaz, was the head of one of two Mameluke factions, the Qasimites and the Fiqarites, between whom the seeds of enmity were sown by the pasha of the time, with the result that a fight took place between the factions outside Cairo, lasting eighty days. At the end of that time, Qasim Iywaz was killed and the office which he had held was given to his son Ismail.

Ottoman Egypt.subject: Indian Languages
Ottoman Egypt.question: Ismail held this office for 16 years, while the pashas were constantly being changed, and succeeded in reconciling the two factions of _____
Ottoman Egypt.fact: Ismail held this office for 16 years, while the pashas were constantly being changed, and succeeded in reconciling the two factions of Mamelukes.

Ottoman Egypt.subject: Indian Languages
Ottoman Egypt.question: In _____, Ismail was assassinated through the machinations of the pasha, and Shirkas Bey—of the opposing faction—was elevated to the office of Sheikh al-Balad in his place
Ottoman Egypt.fact: In 1724, Ismail was assassinated through the machinations of the pasha, and Shirkas Bey—of the opposing faction—was elevated to the office of Sheikh al-Balad in his place.

Ottoman Egypt.subject: Indian Languages
Ottoman Egypt.question: He was soon driven from his post by one of his own faction called Dhu-'l-Fiqar, and fled to _____
Ottoman Egypt.fact: He was soon driven from his post by one of his own faction called Dhu-'l-Fiqar, and fled to Upper Egypt.

Ottoman Egypt.subject: Indian Languages
Ottoman Egypt.question: After a short time, he returned at the head of an army, and in the last of the ensuing battles _____ met his end by drowning
Ottoman Egypt.fact: In 1724, Ismail was assassinated through the machinations of the pasha, and Shirkas Bey—of the opposing faction—was elevated to the office of Sheikh al-Balad in his place. After a short time, he returned at the head of an army, and in the last of the ensuing battles Shirkas Bey met his end by drowning.

Ottoman Egypt.subject: Indian Languages
Ottoman Egypt.question: Dhu-'l-Fiqar was himself assassinated in _____
Ottoman Egypt.fact: Dhu-'l-Fiqar was himself assassinated in 1730.

Ottoman Egypt.subject: Indian Languages
Ottoman Egypt.question: His place was filled by _____, who had served as his general in this war
Ottoman Egypt.fact: His place was filled by Othman Bey, who had served as his general in this war. In 1743, Othman Bey was forced to flee from Egypt by the intrigues of two adventurers, Ibrahim and Ridwan Bey, who—when their scheme had succeeded—began a massacre of beys and others thought to be opposed to them.

Ottoman Egypt.subject: Indian Languages
Ottoman Egypt.question: In _____, Othman Bey was forced to flee from Egypt by the intrigues of two adventurers, Ibrahim and Ridwan Bey, who—when their scheme had succeeded—began a massacre of beys and others thought to be op
Ottoman Egypt.fact: In 1743, Othman Bey was forced to flee from Egypt by the intrigues of two adventurers, Ibrahim and Ridwan Bey, who—when their scheme had succeeded—began a massacre of beys and others thought to be opposed to them.

Ottoman Egypt.subject: Indian Languages
Ottoman Egypt.question: They proceeded to govern Egypt jointly, holding the offices of _____ al-Balad and Amir al-Hajj in alternate years
Ottoman Egypt.fact: They proceeded to govern Egypt jointly, holding the offices of Sheikh al-Balad and Amir al-Hajj in alternate years.

Ottoman Egypt.subject: Indian Languages
Ottoman Egypt.question: An attempt by a subsequent pasha, in accordance with secret orders from _____, was so successful that some of the beys were killed
Ottoman Egypt.fact: An attempt by one of the pashas to remove these two by a coup d'état failed, owing to the loyalty of the beys' armed supporters, who released Ibrahim and Ridwan from prison and compelled the pasha to flee to Constantinople. An attempt by a subsequent pasha, in accordance with secret orders from Constantinople, was so successful that some of the beys were killed.

Ottoman Egypt.subject: Indian Languages
Ottoman Egypt.question: Ibrahim and _____ escaped and compelled the pasha to resign his governorship and return to Constantinople
Ottoman Egypt.fact: Ibrahim and Rilwan escaped and compelled the pasha to resign his governorship and return to Constantinople.

Ottoman Egypt.subject: Indian Languages
Ottoman Egypt.question: The murder of Ibrahim Bey took place in _____, and his colleague Ridwan perished in the subsequent disputes
Ottoman Egypt.fact: The murder of Ibrahim Bey took place in 1755, and his colleague Ridwan perished in the subsequent disputes.

Ottoman Egypt.subject: Indian Languages
Ottoman Egypt.question: Ali Bey, who had first distinguished himself by defending a caravan in _____ against bandits, set himself the task of avenging the death of his former master Ibrahim
Ottoman Egypt.fact: Ali Bey, who had first distinguished himself by defending a caravan in Arabia against bandits, set himself the task of avenging the death of his former master Ibrahim.

Ottoman Egypt.subject: Indian Languages
Ottoman Egypt.question: Here he met one _____, who had injuries to avenge upon Khalil Bey, and the two organised a force with which they returned to Cairo and defeated Khalil
Ottoman Egypt.fact: Here he met one Salib Bey, who had injuries to avenge upon Khalil Bey, and the two organised a force with which they returned to Cairo and defeated Khalil.

Ottoman Egypt.subject: Indian Languages
Ottoman Egypt.question: Khalil was forced to flee to _____, where for a time he concealed himself; eventually he was discovered, sent to Alexandria, and finally strangled
Ottoman Egypt.fact: Khalil was forced to flee to Iaifla, where for a time he concealed himself; eventually he was discovered, sent to Alexandria, and finally strangled.

Ottoman Egypt.subject: Indian Languages
Ottoman Egypt.question: After Ali Bey's victory in _____, he was made Sheikh al-Balad
Ottoman Egypt.fact: After Ali Bey's victory in 1760, he was made Sheikh al-Balad.

Ottoman Egypt.subject: Indian Languages
Ottoman Egypt.question: Ali Bey used severe measures to repress the brigandage of the Bedouins of _____
Ottoman Egypt.fact: Ali Bey used severe measures to repress the brigandage of the Bedouins of Lower Egypt.

Ottoman Egypt.subject: Indian Languages
Ottoman Egypt.question: In _____, a demand came to Ali Bey for a force of 12,000 men, to be employed by the Porte in the Russo-Turkish War of 1768–1774
Ottoman Egypt.fact: In 1769, a demand came to Ali Bey for a force of 12,000 men, to be employed by the Porte in the Russo-Turkish War of 1768–1774.

Ottoman Egypt.subject: Indian Languages
Ottoman Egypt.question: It was suggested at _____, however, that Ali would employ securing his own independence, and a messenger was sent by the Porte to the pasha with orders for Ali's execution
Ottoman Egypt.fact: It was suggested at Constantinople, however, that Ali would employ securing his own independence, and a messenger was sent by the Porte to the pasha with orders for Ali's execution. Ali, being apprised of the despatch of this messenger by his agents in Constantinople, ordered that the messenger be waylaid and killed.

Ottoman Egypt.subject: Indian Languages
Ottoman Egypt.question: Ali, being apprised of the despatch of this messenger by his agents in _____, ordered that the messenger be waylaid and killed
Ottoman Egypt.fact: It was suggested at Constantinople, however, that Ali would employ securing his own independence, and a messenger was sent by the Porte to the pasha with orders for Ali's execution. Ali, being apprised of the despatch of this messenger by his agents in Constantinople, ordered that the messenger be waylaid and killed.

Ottoman Egypt.subject: Indian Languages
Ottoman Egypt.question: His son-in-law, Abu-'l-_____, was sent to subject the Hawwara, who had occupied the land between Aswan and Asyut, and a force of 20,000 men was sent to conquer Yemen
Ottoman Egypt.fact: His son-in-law, Abu-'l-Dhahab, was sent to subject the Hawwara, who had occupied the land between Aswan and Asyut, and a force of 20,000 men was sent to conquer Yemen.

Ottoman Egypt.subject: Indian Languages
Ottoman Egypt.question: An officer named _____ was sent with 8,000 men to acquire the eastern shore of the Red Sea, and Hasan Bey was sent to occupy Jedda
Ottoman Egypt.fact: An officer named Ismail Bey was sent with 8,000 men to acquire the eastern shore of the Red Sea, and Hasan Bey was sent to occupy Jedda.

Ottoman Egypt.subject: Indian Languages
Ottoman Egypt.question: In _____, in virtue of this authorisation, he then struck coins in his own name and ordered his name to be mentioned in public worship
Ottoman Egypt.fact: In 1771, in virtue of this authorisation, he then struck coins in his own name and ordered his name to be mentioned in public worship.

Ottoman Egypt.subject: Indian Languages
Ottoman Egypt.question: Abu-'l-_____ was sent with a force of 30,000 men in the same year to conquer Syria, and agents were sent to negotiate alliances with Venice and Russia
Ottoman Egypt.fact: Abu-'l-Dhahab was sent with a force of 30,000 men in the same year to conquer Syria, and agents were sent to negotiate alliances with Venice and Russia.

Ottoman Egypt.subject: Indian Languages
Ottoman Egypt.question: He proceeded to evacuate Syria, and marched with all the forces he could collect to Upper Egypt, occupying Assiut in April _____
Ottoman Egypt.fact: He proceeded to evacuate Syria, and marched with all the forces he could collect to Upper Egypt, occupying Assiut in April 1772. Ali Bey intended at first to defend himself as long as possible in the Cairo Citadel, but receiving information that his friend Daher al-Umar was still willing to give him refuge, he left Cairo for Syria on 8 April 1772, one day before the entrance of Abu-'l-Dhahab.

Ottoman Egypt.subject: Indian Languages
Ottoman Egypt.question: Having collected additional troops from the _____, he marched on Cairo
Ottoman Egypt.fact: Having collected additional troops from the Bedouins, he marched on Cairo.

Ottoman Egypt.subject: Indian Languages
Ottoman Egypt.question: Ismail Bey was sent by _____ with a force of 3,000 to check his advance, but Bastin Ismil and his troops joined Abu-'l-Dhahab
Ottoman Egypt.fact: Reinforced by Ali Bey's ally Daher al-Umar, Abu-'l-Dahab easily took the chief cities of Palestine and Syria, ending with Damascus, but at this point he appears to have entered into secret negotiations with the Porte, by which he undertook to restore Egypt to Ottoman suzerainty. Ismail Bey was sent by Ali Bey with a force of 3,000 to check his advance, but Bastin Ismil and his troops joined Abu-'l-Dhahab.

Ottoman Egypt.subject: Indian Languages
Ottoman Egypt.question: A Russian vessel anchored outside the port and, in accordance with the agreement which he had made with the _____, he was supplied with stores, ammunition, and a force of 3,000 Albanians
Ottoman Egypt.fact: A Russian vessel anchored outside the port and, in accordance with the agreement which he had made with the Russian Empire, he was supplied with stores, ammunition, and a force of 3,000 Albanians.

Ottoman Egypt.subject: Indian Languages
Ottoman Egypt.question: He sent one of his officers, _____ al-Tantawi, to recover the Syrian towns evacuated by Abu-'l-Dhahab now in the possession of the Porte
Ottoman Egypt.fact: Ismail Bey was sent by Ali Bey with a force of 3,000 to check his advance, but Bastin Ismil and his troops joined Abu-'l-Dhahab. Ali Bey intended at first to defend himself as long as possible in the Cairo Citadel, but receiving information that his friend Daher al-Umar was still willing to give him refuge, he left Cairo for Syria on 8 April 1772, one day before the entrance of Abu-'l-Dhahab.

Ottoman Egypt.subject: Indian Languages
Ottoman Egypt.question: He himself took _____ and Gaza, the former of which he gave to his friend Daher al-Umar
Ottoman Egypt.fact: He himself took Jaffa and Gaza, the former of which he gave to his friend Daher al-Umar.

Ottoman Egypt.subject: Indian Languages
Ottoman Egypt.question: On 1 February _____, he received information from Cairo that Abu-'l-Dhahab had made himself Sheikh al-Balad, and in that capacity was practising unheard-of extortions, which were making Egyptians call
Ottoman Egypt.fact: On 1 February 1773, he received information from Cairo that Abu-'l-Dhahab had made himself Sheikh al-Balad, and in that capacity was practising unheard-of extortions, which were making Egyptians call for the return of Ali Bey.

Ottoman Egypt.subject: Indian Languages
Ottoman Egypt.question: He accordingly started for Egypt at the head of an army of 8,000 men, and on 19 April met the army of Abu-'l-Dhahab at _____
Ottoman Egypt.fact: He accordingly started for Egypt at the head of an army of 8,000 men, and on 19 April met the army of Abu-'l-Dhahab at Salihiyya Madrasa.

Ottoman Egypt.subject: Indian Languages
Ottoman Egypt.question: The result was a complete defeat for his army, after which he declined to leave his tent; he was captured after a brave resistance and taken to _____, where he died seven days later
Ottoman Egypt.fact: On 1 February 1773, he received information from Cairo that Abu-'l-Dhahab had made himself Sheikh al-Balad, and in that capacity was practising unheard-of extortions, which were making Egyptians call for the return of Ali Bey. The result was a complete defeat for his army, after which he declined to leave his tent; he was captured after a brave resistance and taken to Cairo, where he died seven days later.

Ottoman Egypt.subject: Indian Languages
Ottoman Egypt.question: After taking multiple cities in Palestine, Abu-'l-Dhahab died, the cause being unknown; Murad Bey, another of the deserters at Salihiyya, brought his forces back to Egypt on 26 May _____
Ottoman Egypt.fact: After taking multiple cities in Palestine, Abu-'l-Dhahab died, the cause being unknown; Murad Bey, another of the deserters at Salihiyya, brought his forces back to Egypt on 26 May 1775.

Ottoman Egypt.subject: Indian Languages
Ottoman Egypt.question: He, with Ibrahim, decided to flee to _____ and await the trend of events
Ottoman Egypt.fact: He, with Ibrahim, decided to flee to Upper Egypt and await the trend of events.

Ottoman Egypt.subject: Indian Languages
Ottoman Egypt.question: In January _____, a terrible plague raged in Cairo and elsewhere in Egypt, to which Ismail Bey and most of his family fell victims
Ottoman Egypt.fact: In January 1791, a terrible plague raged in Cairo and elsewhere in Egypt, to which Ismail Bey and most of his family fell victims.

Ottoman Egypt.subject: Indian Languages
Ottoman Egypt.question: Owing to the need for competent rulers, _____ and Murad Bey were sent for, and resumed their dual government
Ottoman Egypt.fact: Owing to the need for competent rulers, Ibrahim Bey and Murad Bey were sent for, and resumed their dual government.

Ottoman Egypt.subject: Indian Languages
Ottoman Egypt.question: They were still in office in _____ when Napoleon Bonaparte entered Egypt
Ottoman Egypt.fact: They were still in office in 1798 when Napoleon Bonaparte entered Egypt.

Ottoman Egypt.subject: Indian Languages
Ottoman Egypt.question: It does not appear that the proclamation convinced many _____ of the truth of these professions
Ottoman Egypt.fact: That there might be no doubt of the friendly feeling of the French to the Porte, villages and towns which capitulated to the invaders were required to hoist the flags of both the Porte and the French republic, and in the thanksgiving prescribed to the Egyptians for their deliverance from the Mamluks, prayer was to be offered for both the sultan and the French army. It does not appear that the proclamation convinced many Egyptians of the truth of these professions.

Ottoman Egypt.subject: Indian Languages
Ottoman Egypt.question: A municipal council was established in Cairo, consisting of persons taken from the ranks of the sheiks, the _____, and the French
Ottoman Egypt.fact: A municipal council was set up in Cairo, consisting of persons taken from the ranks of the sheiks, the Mamluks, and the French.

Ottoman Egypt.subject: Indian Languages
Ottoman Egypt.question: Soon after, delegates from _____ and other important towns were added
Ottoman Egypt.fact: Soon after, delegates from Alexandria and other important towns were added.

Ottoman Egypt.subject: Indian Languages
Ottoman Egypt.question: This council did little more than register the decrees of the _____ commander, who continued to exercise dictatorial power
Ottoman Egypt.fact: A deputation was sent from Al-Azhar Mosque to Bonaparte to ascertain his intentions; these proved to be a repetition of the terms of his proclamation, and—though the combination of loyalty to the French with loyalty to the sultan was incompatible—a good understanding was at first set up between the invaders and the Egyptians. A municipal council was set up in Cairo, consisting of persons taken from the ranks of the sheiks, the Mamluks, and the French.

Ottoman Egypt.subject: Indian Languages
Ottoman Egypt.question: The headquarters of the insurrection were in the _____ of Azhar
Ottoman Egypt.fact: The headquarters of the insurrection were in the University of Azhar.

Ottoman Egypt.subject: Indian Languages
Ottoman Egypt.question: On this occasion, the _____ general Dupuy, lieutenant-governor of Cairo, was killed
Ottoman Egypt.fact: This council did little more than register the decrees of the French commander, who continued to exercise dictatorial power. On this occasion, the French general Dupuy, lieutenant-governor of Cairo, was killed.

Ottoman Egypt.subject: Indian Languages
Ottoman Egypt.question: Murad Bey and _____ had taken advantage of this opportunity to collect their forces and attempt a joint attack on Cairo, but Bonaparte arrived in time to defeat it
Ottoman Egypt.fact: Murad Bey and Ibrahim Bey had taken advantage of this opportunity to collect their forces and attempt a joint attack on Cairo, but Bonaparte arrived in time to defeat it.

Ottoman Egypt.subject: Indian Languages
Ottoman Egypt.question: In the last week of July, he inflicted a crushing defeat on the _____ army that had landed at Aboukir, aided by the British fleet commanded by Sir Sidney Smith
Ottoman Egypt.fact: In the last week of July, he inflicted a crushing defeat on the Turkish army that had landed at Aboukir, aided by the British fleet commanded by Sir Sidney Smith.

Ottoman Egypt.subject: Indian Languages
Ottoman Egypt.question: Shortly after his victory, _____ left Egypt, having appointed Kléber to govern in his absence—which he informed the sheiks of Cairo was not to last more than three months
Ottoman Egypt.fact: In consequence of dispatches that reached Bonaparte on 3 January 1799, announcing the intention of the Porte to invade the country with the object of recovering it by force, Bonaparte resolved on his Syrian expedition, and appointed governors for Cairo, Alexandria, and Upper Egypt, to govern during his absence. Murad Bey and Ibrahim Bey had taken advantage of this opportunity to collect their forces and attempt a joint attack on Cairo, but Bonaparte arrived in time to defeat it.

Ottoman Egypt.subject: Indian Languages
Ottoman Egypt.question: Kléber regarded the condition of the French invaders as extremely perilous, and wrote to inform the _____ of the facts
Ottoman Egypt.fact: Kléber regarded the condition of the French invaders as extremely perilous, and wrote to inform the French Republic of the facts.

Ottoman Egypt.subject: Indian Languages
Ottoman Egypt.question: The first force had some success, in consequence of which the Turks agreed to a convention on 24 January _____, by virtue of which the French were to quit Egypt
Ottoman Egypt.fact: The first force had some success, in consequence of which the Turks agreed to a convention on 24 January 1800, by virtue of which the French were to quit Egypt.

Ottoman Egypt.subject: Indian Languages
Ottoman Egypt.question: The Turkish troops advanced to _____, where they were received by the sheiks from Cairo; the Mamluks also returned to Cairo from their hiding-places
Ottoman Egypt.fact: The Turkish troops advanced to Bilbeis, where they were received by the sheiks from Cairo; the Mamluks also returned to Cairo from their hiding-places.

Ottoman Egypt.subject: Indian Languages
Ottoman Egypt.question: His departure, with most of the army, to attack the Turks at _____ led to riots in Cairo
Ottoman Egypt.fact: His departure, with most of the army, to attack the Turks at Mataria led to riots in Cairo.

Ottoman Egypt.subject: Indian Languages
Ottoman Egypt.question: The national party was unable to gain possession of the citadel, and Kléber, having defeated the _____, was soon able to return to the capital
Ottoman Egypt.fact: His departure, with most of the army, to attack the Turks at Mataria led to riots in Cairo. The national party was unable to gain possession of the citadel, and Kléber, having defeated the Turks, was soon able to return to the capital.

Ottoman Egypt.subject: Indian Languages
Ottoman Egypt.question: On 14 _____ he bombarded Bulaq, and proceeded to bombard Cairo itself, which was taken the following night
Ottoman Egypt.fact: On 14 April he bombarded Bulaq, and proceeded to bombard Cairo itself, which was taken the following night.

Ottoman Egypt.subject: Indian Languages
Ottoman Egypt.question: Murad Bey sought an interview with Kléber, and succeeded in obtaining the government of _____ from him
Ottoman Egypt.fact: Murad Bey sought an interview with Kléber, and succeeded in obtaining the government of Upper Egypt from him.

Ottoman Egypt.subject: Indian Languages
Ottoman Egypt.question: Murad Bey died shortly afterwards and was succeeded by _____ al-Bardisi
Ottoman Egypt.fact: Murad Bey died shortly afterwards and was succeeded by Osman Bey al-Bardisi.

Ottoman Egypt.subject: Indian Languages
Ottoman Egypt.question: Although they gave him no support, three of the sheikhs were executed by the _____ as accessories-before-the-fact
Ottoman Egypt.fact: Although they gave him no support, three of the sheikhs were executed by the French as accessories-before-the-fact. The command of the army then devolved on General Jacques-Francois Menou, a man who had professed Islam, and who endeavoured to conciliate the Muslim population by various measures—such as excluding all Christians (with the exception of one Frenchman) from the divan, replacing Copts who were in government service with Muslims, and subjecting French residents to taxes.

Ottoman Egypt.subject: Indian Languages
Ottoman Egypt.question: Whatever popularity might have been gained by these measures was counteracted by his declaration of a _____ protectorate over Egypt, which was to count as a French colony
Ottoman Egypt.fact: Although they gave him no support, three of the sheikhs were executed by the French as accessories-before-the-fact. The command of the army then devolved on General Jacques-Francois Menou, a man who had professed Islam, and who endeavoured to conciliate the Muslim population by various measures—such as excluding all Christians (with the exception of one Frenchman) from the divan, replacing Copts who were in government service with Muslims, and subjecting French residents to taxes.

Ottoman Egypt.subject: Indian Languages
Ottoman Egypt.question: On the 25th, fresh Ottoman reinforcements arrived with the fleet of the _____ Küçük Hüseyin Pasha
Ottoman Egypt.fact: On the 25th, fresh Ottoman reinforcements arrived with the fleet of the Kapudan Pasha Küçük Hüseyin Pasha.

Ottoman Egypt.subject: Indian Languages
Ottoman Egypt.question: A combined Anglo-Ottoman force was sent to take _____
Ottoman Egypt.fact: A combined Anglo-Ottoman force was sent to take Rosetta.

Ottoman Egypt.subject: Indian Languages
Ottoman Egypt.question: On 30 _____, Menou was compelled to accept similar conditions, and his force of 10,000 men left Alexandria for Europe in September
Ottoman Egypt.fact: On 30 May, Augustin Daniel Belliard, the French commander in Cairo, was assailed on two sides by British forces under General John Hely-Hutchinson and Ottoman troops under Yusuf Pasha; after negotiations, Belliard agreed to evacuate Cairo and to sail with his 13,734 remaining soldiers to France. On 30 August, Menou was compelled to accept similar conditions, and his force of 10,000 men left Alexandria for Europe in September.

Ottoman Egypt.subject: Indian Languages
Ottoman Egypt.question: This was the termination of the _____ occupation of Egypt, as the French in defeat would never return to Egypt during Napoleon's rule
Ottoman Egypt.fact: On 30 May, Augustin Daniel Belliard, the French commander in Cairo, was assailed on two sides by British forces under General John Hely-Hutchinson and Ottoman troops under Yusuf Pasha; after negotiations, Belliard agreed to evacuate Cairo and to sail with his 13,734 remaining soldiers to France. This was the termination of the French occupation of Egypt, as the French in defeat would never return to Egypt during Napoleon's rule.

Ottoman Egypt.subject: Indian Languages
Ottoman Egypt.question: The chief permanent monument of the occupation was the _____ de l'Egypte, compiled by the French savants who accompanied the expedition
Ottoman Egypt.fact: The chief permanent monument of the occupation was the Description de l'Egypte, compiled by the French savants who accompanied the expedition.

Ottoman Egypt.subject: Indian Languages
Ottoman Egypt.question: In defiance of promises to the _____, orders were transmitted from Constantinople to Hüseyin Pasha to ensnare and put to death the principal beys
Ottoman Egypt.fact: In defiance of promises to the British Government, orders were transmitted from Constantinople to Hüseyin Pasha to ensnare and put to death the principal beys.

Ottoman Egypt.subject: Indian Languages
Ottoman Egypt.question: Among the prisoners was _____ al-Bardisi, who was severely wounded
Ottoman Egypt.fact: Among the prisoners was Osman Bey al-Bardisi, who was severely wounded.

Ottoman Egypt.subject: Indian Languages
Ottoman Egypt.question: The British General Hutchinson, informed of this treachery, immediately took threatening measures against the Turks, causing them to surrender the killed, wounded, and imprisoned _____ to him
Ottoman Egypt.fact: The British General Hutchinson, informed of this treachery, immediately took threatening measures against the Turks, causing them to surrender the killed, wounded, and imprisoned Egyptians to him.

Ottoman Egypt.subject: Indian Languages
